workflows.name: Accessible technical-publication and controlled print-delivery review
workflows.scope: Acrobat/PDF professional review complements existing InDesign/layout and press workflow requirements; no unrelated product expansion.
workflows.scale: Proposed corpus: 500-page multilingual technical manual, many linked references, structured tables, tagged figures, annotations and multiple output profiles.
steps: Import canonical PDF/native stories/assets with editability report.
Review/annotate revision-specific pages, compare structured changes and rendered output, correct reading order/table/tag findings.
Apply output-profile-specific preflight and manage signatures/encryption explicitly.
Sanitize/redact through full rewrite when selected; discard hidden originals/history from that output only.
Export, reopen independently and inspect content/structure/render and raw decompressed bytes.
workflows.handoff: Same approved native stories/figures feed screen/press/digital outputs; review comments bind stable revision/object identities rather than stale pixel coordinates.
failures: Perfect-looking page with inaccessible semantic reading order
Redacted bytes retained in incremental revisions or embedded original
Signed file invalidated without explicit finding
controls: Independent conformity validators and manual output reading-order checks
Explicit full-rewrite export route and byte/image residue inspection
Typed signature status and immutable-original retention choice

workflows.name: Reusable design-system to accessible local web-authoring delivery
workflows.scope: Preserves existing STU-WEB/Dreamweaver prep; published result may be a website while Studio itself remains native desktop.
workflows.scale: Proposed corpus: 200-page site, linked graphics/components, 10 locale variants and responsive viewport targets.
steps: Open local HTML/CSS/JS/site assets in existing native editor capability.
Bind shared Studio vector/raster assets and design tokens to DOM/CSS output with source relation receipts.
Inspect DOM and rendered preview with shared properties panel and model-readable target IDs.
Apply responsive media queries, reusable templates/library content and semantic/accessibility checks.
Review local Git branch changes using existing editor/Git owners; export selected canonical site assets and staging package.
Publish only through explicitly authorized optional deployment adapter, with no required hosted dependency.
workflows.handoff: Native visual assets, component tokens and code views share an asset identity; DOM edits do not reimplement WP012 source-editor or filesystem mechanics.
failures: Preview correct at one viewport but broken at constrained sizes
controls: Bounded sandboxed preview and exact canonical scope counts
Reuse existing Git/code-editing/publishing authority and permission boundary

sources.checked: Official Git workflow and navigation to local-site/responsive/DOM/templates/preview documentation

proof_status: No website/editor/PDF implementation or runtime proof in this session.
